book_cn: 上外版选择性必修第三册
unit_cn: Unit 3 Exploring the Unknown 探索未知
source: 上外版(沪教版)选择性必修三 Unit 3 词表(真词,跳过专有名词如 Stonehenge/Mariana Trench);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、探索未知(巨石阵/海沟/孤绝之地/古代谜团/科学探索)主题、含目标词;多义给多个中文释义。

words.meaning_cn: 纪念碑;遗迹;不朽的作品
words.example_en: Stonehenge is an ancient monument that still puzzles experts.
words.example_cn: 巨石阵是一处至今仍让专家困惑的古老遗迹。

words.example_en: How the stones were moved remains a mystery to this day.
words.example_cn: 这些石头是如何被搬运的至今仍是个谜。

words.example_en: One theory says that Stonehenge was used as a calendar.
words.example_cn: 一种理论认为巨石阵曾被用作日历。

words.example_en: There is no solid evidence that aliens built the monument.
words.example_cn: 没有确凿证据表明这处遗迹是外星人建造的。

words.example_en: Columbus held a firm belief that the world was round.
words.example_cn: 哥伦布坚信世界是圆的。

words.example_en: There is no doubt that the trench is the deepest place on Earth.
words.example_cn: 毫无疑问,这条海沟是地球上最深的地方。

words.example_en: The construction of Stonehenge took place over many centuries.
words.example_cn: 巨石阵的建造历经了许多个世纪。

words.example_en: Some experts call Stonehenge a kind of primitive computer.
words.example_cn: 一些专家把巨石阵称作一种原始的计算机。

words.example_en: He claimed that the stones could predict an eclipse.
words.example_cn: 他声称这些石头能预测日食。

words.example_en: Ancient people were amazed by a sudden eclipse of the sun.
words.example_cn: 突如其来的日食令古人惊叹不已。

words.example_en: The stones point to the sun at the summer solstice.
words.example_cn: 这些石头在夏至时指向太阳。

words.meaning_cn: 无把握;不确定的事;疑团
words.example_en: There is still great uncertainty about who built the monument.
words.example_cn: 关于这处遗迹的建造者仍有很大的不确定性。

words.example_en: How could they calculate the movements of the sun and the moon?
words.example_cn: 他们怎么能推算出太阳和月亮的运行呢?

words.example_en: Humans have always longed to explore the unknown.
words.example_cn: 人类一直渴望探索未知。

words.example_en: People have a strong desire to go beyond familiar places.
words.example_cn: 人们有一种走出熟悉之地的强烈渴望。

words.meaning_cn: 在……另一边;超出;在更远处
words.example_en: Early explorers wanted to see what lay beyond the ocean.
words.example_cn: 早期的探险者想看看海洋那一边有什么。

words.example_en: One day humans may explore the vastness of the universe.
words.example_cn: 总有一天人类或许会探索浩瀚的宇宙。

words.example_en: There seems to be no end to humanity's appetite for exploring.
words.example_cn: 人类探索的渴望似乎没有尽头。

words.example_en: We are born wanting to explore our surroundings.
words.example_cn: 我们生来就想探索周遭的环境。

words.example_en: Vale do Javari is one of the most isolated places on Earth.
words.example_cn: 查瓦利河谷是地球上最与世隔绝的地方之一。

words.example_en: Few people have ever reached the bottom of the deep trench.
words.example_cn: 很少有人曾到达过这条深沟的底部。

words.example_en: Previous expeditions revealed strange creatures in the deep sea.
words.example_cn: 以往的探险曾发现深海中的奇怪生物。

words.example_en: The rainforest is home to many indigenous people.
words.example_cn: 这片雨林是许多原住民的家园。

words.example_en: The valley is one of the largest indigenous territories in Brazil.
words.example_cn: 这片河谷是巴西最大的原住民领地之一。

words.example_en: The Javari is the most important river system in the region.
words.example_cn: 查瓦利河是该地区最重要的河流水系。

words.example_en: Some tribes were first discovered through satellite images.
words.example_cn: 一些部落最初是通过卫星图像被发现的。

words.example_en: Satellite images helped scientists find the hidden village.
words.example_cn: 卫星图像帮助科学家找到了那个隐蔽的村落。

words.example_en: Brazilian law prohibits outsiders from entering the region.
words.example_cn: 巴西法律禁止外来者进入该地区。

words.example_en: A local group is dedicated to protecting the forest.
words.example_cn: 一个当地组织致力于保护这片森林。

words.example_en: The reserve protects the forest from exploitation.
words.example_cn: 这片保护区使森林免遭开发。

words.example_en: Sharp limestone makes this nature reserve dangerous to explore.
words.example_cn: 锋利的石灰岩使这处自然保护区探索起来很危险。

words.example_en: The needle-shaped rocks rise sharply from the ground.
words.example_cn: 这些针状的岩石从地面尖锐地耸起。

words.example_en: The limestone formations are terribly sharp and dangerous.
words.example_cn: 这些石灰岩岩柱锋利无比、十分危险。

words.example_en: The sharp rocks pose a serious danger to explorers.
words.example_cn: 这些锋利的岩石给探险者带来严重危险。

words.example_en: The name derives from a local word about walking.
words.example_cn: 这个名字源自一个与行走有关的当地词语。

words.example_en: No one can safely walk barefoot across these rocks.
words.example_cn: 没人能赤脚安全地走过这些岩石。

words.example_en: The stones have edges sharp enough to cut through flesh.
words.example_cn: 这些石头的边缘锋利得足以划破皮肉。

words.example_en: A fall here could cut the flesh with deadly effect.
words.example_cn: 在这里摔倒可能会划破皮肉,造成致命后果。

words.example_en: Each enormous stone weighs as much as fifty tons.
words.example_cn: 每块巨大的石头重达五十吨。

words.example_en: Moving the stones must have been an incredible journey.
words.example_cn: 搬运这些石头一定是一次惊人的旅程。

words.example_en: The origin of this historic site is still unknown to us.
words.example_cn: 这处历史遗址的由来我们至今仍不清楚。

words.example_en: The guide often referred to an old theory about the giants.
words.example_cn: 导游常常提到一个关于巨人的古老理论。

words.example_en: Why did ancient people devote so much energy to this monument?
words.example_cn: 古人为何把这么多精力投入到这处遗迹上?

words.example_en: The rebuilding took place over hundreds of years.
words.example_cn: 这次重建历经数百年才完成。

words.example_en: In spite of the danger, explorers still long to reach the place.
words.example_cn: 尽管危险,探险者仍渴望抵达那个地方。

words.example_en: In fact, the word means "a place where one cannot walk."
words.example_cn: 确切地说,这个词意为“一个无法行走的地方”。

words.example_en: The strange name is derived from a local word.
words.example_cn: 这个奇怪的名字源自一个当地词语。

words.example_en: Water may have arrived in the form of ice on an asteroid.
words.example_cn: 水或许是以冰的形式随小行星到来的。

words.example_en: No one knows how many people were involved in the work.
words.example_cn: 没人知道有多少人参与了这项工作。

words.example_en: For some reason, the early people rearranged the bluestones.
words.example_cn: 出于某种原因,远古的人们重新排列了这些蓝砂岩。
